ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance, Actuarial Science, and dual degree Accountancy majors-space permitting. On November 24th, any remaining seats will be closed and seat limits will be set below the number of registered students. Registered students who drop the course can request to reregister for the dropped section, space permitting. Prerequisite (FIN 221) will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 221 will be removed from FIN 300.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Business Administration or Actuarial Science or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
